What this browser edition does—and its limits

This is an early standalone browser vault, not a port of the complete macOS app. Native MCP, REST agent access, Touch ID, payments, and desktop vault import are not included. There is no AI model or semantic search.

Encryption uses Web Crypto, PBKDF2-SHA-256 (600,000 iterations), and AES-256-GCM. Your key stays in memory while unlocked. It cannot protect against a compromised browser, extension, or altered app code. Browser storage may be cleared or evicted; export backups regularly. This version needs a network connection to load and does not promise offline restart. The hosting provider serves the page and can receive standard request metadata; vault contents are not uploaded.
